message: Good conditions for trout right now. Worth a cast.
positive_factors: Falling barometric pressure — fish often feed ahead of a front
negative_factors: Bright, clear skies can push fish deep and slow feeding

tactics.where: Shoreline & shallow cover — favor the windward shore
tactics.where_reason: fish push shallow toward the bank in low light / cool water; wind stacks plankton and baitfish on the wind-blown bank
tactics.method_reason: wind makes fly casting tough and rewards covering water

fly_options.name: Woolly Buggers / leeches (slow strip)
fly_options.why: all-purpose in low light, wind, or stained water — both species

fly_options.name: Streamers (sculpin / baitfish)
fly_options.why: active fish chasing bait; strip on a sink-tip

fly_options.name: Nymphs (pheasant tail, hare's ear) under an indicator
fly_options.why: subsurface when nothing's rising / bright midday

spin_options.name: Jigs & soft plastics (worked deep)
spin_options.why: bright sun / warm water — fish off the bank and on structure

tactics.season_note: Summer: bass prime in warm shallows early/late; trout slide deep and cool midday.
tactics.summary: Either — slight bass edge · Shoreline & shallow cover · Shallow — top ~0–8 ft · lean spin fishing
